packageRules.description: Group OCI container image updates into a single PR
hermes-agent tags a canary build on every push to its release branches - never propose those as an upgrade, only numbered releases

Sync flake.lock in the same commit when hermes-agent's release tag is bumped - its regex customManager edits flake.nix directly and has no way to invoke nix itself, unlike Renovate's built-in nix manager (which handles flake.lock via its own lockFileMaintenance delegation to `nix`)

Sync the fixed-output sha256 in the same commit when Bead Me Up, Scotty's tag is bumped - a stale hash here hard-fails the next build (fetchFromGitHub content no longer matches the pin), not just silent drift

customManagers.description: Track OCI container image versions in NixOS container definitions
Track hermes-agent's release tag pinned in flake.nix (the built-in nix manager only follows git refs/commits, not release tags)

Track Bead Me Up, Scotty's release tag pinned in bead-me-up-scotty.nix - it's a fetchFromGitHub source pin built locally via podman, not a published image, so the generic OCI-image rule above never sees it
